title: Lunar Staff

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Allows you to pick up even more objects at once for longer.

body:
"A staff made of pure rock, moon rock! Control matter around you, levitate items, make others bow down before you!"


Description

The Lunar Staff is a tool that was added in the 2024 Halloween Event that can be crafted by placing a Hardened Moon Rod and a Moon Shard on the altar found at the top of the Manor. The type of Moon Shard used to craft the Lunar Staff must be the Full Moon. It allows the user to project a medium-sized zone that lets them pick up multiple loose objects similar to the Grabby Grabber and the Grabbiest Grabber.It can hold objects for 5 minutes.

Trivia

The Lunar Staff can grab heavier objects than the Grabbiest Grabber and Grabby Grabber.

The Lunar Staff has a longer range than the Grabbiest Grabber and Grabby Grabber.
